title: IMF warns of regional economic contraction as conflict disrupts trade
excerpt: What the IMF’s regional outlook says, why the 1.3% forecast applies to the combined region rather than Pakistan alone, and which risks matter for readers.
dek: The Fund’s latest outlook points to how conflict-related disruption to energy, shipping and tourism can ripple through economies. Pakistan’s exposure will depend on energy costs, trade conditions and domestic policy.
source: Reuters reporting on the IMF regional outlook
seoTitle: IMF warns of regional economic contraction as conflict disrupts trade | NationalNews.pk
seoDescription: The IMF’s latest regional outlook warns of economic contraction amid conflict-related energy and trade disruptions. What it could mean for Pakistan.

title: Ten militants killed in Gwadar operations, one civilian also dead: ISPR
excerpt: Pakistan's military says ten militants, including a woman, were killed during operations in and around Gwadar city and near the Gabd border crossing with Iran. One civilian was killed; ISPR says no security personnel were hurt.
dek: The operations came days after Pakistan briefly suspended trade through two crossings with Iran. What the military's statement says — and what remains unverified.
source: ISPR statement as reported by Arab News, Geo News and other outlets
seoTitle: Ten militants killed in Gwadar operations, one civilian also dead: ISPR | NationalNews.pk
seoDescription: ISPR says security forces killed ten militants including a female militant in Gwadar and near the Gabd border crossing; one civilian was killed and several vehicles damaged.

safetyReviewed.note: Full text read and approved: factual report of the ISPR statement itself; all military claims attributed and marked unverified; no editorializing, no criticism of state institutions. Routine counterterrorism coverage that mainstream Pakistani outlets publish daily.

title: Seven killed in shooting at church funeral in southern Jordan
excerpt: Gunmen opened fire during a funeral at a church in Hmoud, Karak governorate, killing seven people and wounding at least 34, officials say. A manhunt is under way and Jordan's king pledged the "harshest penalties".
dek: Interior Minister Mazen al-Faraya called the attack "unparalleled in the history" of Jordan. The attackers arrived by car and fled after a roughly fifteen-minute shooting.
seoTitle: Seven killed in shooting at church funeral in southern Jordan | NationalNews.pk
seoDescription: At least 34 wounded after gunmen fired on mourners at a Greek Orthodox church in Hmoud, Karak. Jordanian officials call it a terrorist act; manhunt under way.

safetyReviewed.note: Full text read and approved: BBC-sourced foreign news (Jordan); factual wire-style reporting, no graphic detail, no sectarian content; officials quoted with attribution. Standard world-news coverage.

title: Weight-loss drugs are changing beauty habits, says L'Oreal chief
excerpt: L'Oreal's CEO says GLP-1 weight-loss medicines are having a visible impact on skincare consumption. The group reported 7.7% sales growth for the quarter to September and is positioning dermatology brands to serve GLP-1 users.
dek: Nicolas Hieronimus called the rise of GLP-1 drugs "a very important phenomenon for us". L'Oreal has raised its stake in Galderma to 20% and is testing products for GLP-1 users.
seoTitle: Weight-loss drugs are changing beauty habits, says L'Oreal chief | NationalNews.pk
seoDescription: L'Oreal's CEO says GLP-1 medicines are hitting skincare consumption. Sales rose 7.7% in the quarter to September; brands are adapting products for GLP-1 users.
imageAlt: Weight-loss drugs are changing beauty habits, says L'Oreal chief

title: PSG v Lyon postponed by a day as Paris prepares for protests
excerpt: Paris St-Germain's Ligue 1 match against Lyon has been moved from Sunday to Monday after police barred the original date, the league said, as the capital prepares for another weekend of demonstrations.
dek: Lyon lead the table with PSG second. The match now falls on the same day as the Ballon d'Or ceremony in London.
seoTitle: PSG v Lyon postponed by a day as Paris prepares for protests | NationalNews.pk
seoDescription: The LFP moved PSG v Lyon from Sunday 19:45 GMT to Monday 20:30 GMT after police prohibited the original date amid protest planning in Paris.
imageAlt: PSG v Lyon postponed by a day as Paris prepares for protests

title: Argentina drops criminal investigation into President Milei over $LIBRA crypto scandal
excerpt: A federal judge dismissed the case at prosecutors' request, finding no "criminally relevant deception" in the 2025 memecoin episode that crashed within hours of the president's since-deleted post.
dek: The decision closes one of the most closely watched legal threats to Milei's presidency.
seoTitle: Milei $LIBRA case: Argentina drops crypto investigation against president
seoDescription: A federal judge dropped the criminal investigation into President Javier Milei over the $LIBRA memecoin crash, finding no criminally relevant deception. What the ruling says.

title: Meta strikes deal to keep Zuckerberg in California over billionaire tax that could cost him $10 billion
excerpt: Meta's "Founder Alignment Agreement" grants Zuckerberg additional sellable shares to offset a proposed one-time 5% California tax on billionaires. Shares still fell more than 7%.
dek: The eight-year pact stays in force even if the tax never passes — but investors wiped $100 billion off Meta anyway.
imageAlt: Mark Zuckerberg, chief executive of Meta
seoTitle: Meta's Founder Alignment Agreement: Zuckerberg compensated over California billionaire tax
seoDescription: Meta agreed a stock-grant deal to keep Mark Zuckerberg in California despite a proposed 5% billionaire tax worth about $10bn to him. How the deal works and why shares fell.

title: 'I'm 96 and have 15 million followers': The grannies taking over TikTok
excerpt: Grandma Droniak, Nonna Gracie, Viv Truran and Barbara Costello have turned late-life fame into serious income — and brands are paying a premium for their unusually loyal audiences.
dek: Older creators offer "deeply established, highly loyal" communities with real purchasing power, marketers say.
imageAlt: An older woman filming a video for social media
seoTitle: TikTok grannies: how creators in their 80s and 90s built huge followings
seoDescription: From Grandma Droniak (96, 15m followers) to Brunch with Babs, older creators are dominating TikTok — and earning enough to cover $12,000 monthly nursing home fees.

title: Shan Masood dropped as Pakistan turn to youth for Sri Lanka Tests
excerpt: Pakistan have omitted former Test captain Shan Masood — along with Imam-ul-Haq, Abdullah Shafique and Mohammad Rizwan — from a revamped 14-member squad for the two-Test ICC World Test Championship series against Sri Lanka, with Babar Azam staying on as captain.
dek: Three maiden call-ups — Mohammad Taha, Mohammad Suleman and Sameer Minhas — head a youth-first selection for the Rawalpindi and Lahore Tests starting November 9.
seoTitle: Pakistan Test squad vs Sri Lanka 2026: Shan Masood dropped, Babar Azam captain | NationalNews.pk
seoDescription: Pakistan's 14-member Test squad for Sri Lanka drops Shan Masood, Imam-ul-Haq, Abdullah Shafique and Mohammad Rizwan. Babar Azam captains three debutants in Rawalpindi (Nov 9) and Lahore (Nov 17).

title: Aurangzeb rules out consumption-led growth, vows tariff reforms will continue
excerpt: Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb says Pakistan will not chase liquidity-fuelled, consumption-led growth, as the government enters year two of tariff reforms aimed at export competitiveness.
dek: Speaking at LUMS, the finance minister pointed to IT exports rising from under $1 billion to $4.6 billion, exporter financing at 4.5 percent, and a current account deficit near 0.1 percent of GDP.
seoTitle: Aurangzeb rules out consumption-led growth as Pakistan tariff reforms continue | NationalNews.pk
seoDescription: Pakistan Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb says tariff reform has 'no turning back' and rules out consumption-led growth, citing IT exports of $4.6bn and a fiscal deficit at a 22-year low.

title: Eagle's Nest fire leaves Hitler's Alpine retreat 'largely destroyed'
excerpt: Some 200 emergency personnel fought a blaze that left the Nazi-era Eagle's Nest above Berchtesgaden largely destroyed. A 33-year-old German man was arrested near the scene.
dek: The 1938 mountain retreat survived the fall of the Third Reich and became a major tourist destination. Bavaria's interior minister says it will 'under no circumstances remain a ruin'.
imageAlt: Fire damaged the Kehlsteinhaus, known as the Eagle's Nest, above Berchtesgaden in the Bavarian Alps
seoTitle: Eagle's Nest fire: Hitler's Alpine retreat largely destroyed, man arrested | NationalNews.pk
seoDescription: A fire has left the Kehlsteinhaus — the Eagle's Nest, Hitler's Nazi-era Alpine retreat in Bavaria — largely destroyed. A 33-year-old man was arrested; a political motive is being considered.

title: Ras Al Khaimah closes all beaches as UAE grapples with offshore oil spill
excerpt: The northern emirate shut its beaches until further notice, a day after Umm Al Quwain and Sharjah closed theirs following an offshore oil leak believed to have come from a tanker.
dek: Residents reported pungent coastal odours across Sharjah, Ajman and Umm Al Quwain. The environment ministry says technical teams are containing the leak and assessing the shoreline.
seoTitle: UAE oil spill: Ras Al Khaimah closes all beaches after offshore leak | NationalNews.pk
seoDescription: Ras Al Khaimah has closed all beaches until further notice after an offshore oil leak triggered closures in Umm Al Quwain and Sharjah. Containment and shoreline assessment are under way.
